# DataGridEditMode

`Flare.Components.DataGridEditMode`

Edit mode for the DataGrid.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `None` | `0` | No editing. |
| `Inline` | `1` | Inline row editing (one row at a time). |
| `Batch` | `2` | Batch editing (multiple rows, save all at once). |
| `Cell` | `3` | Cell editing (click to edit individual cells). |

## Used by components

- `FlareDataGrid`
